evals.name: slop-cleanup
evals.prompt: the docs in ./evals/fixtures/repo-c were mostly written by coding-agent sessions and it shows. can you clean them up?
evals.expected_output: Chat residue, the handoff summary and the test-pass assertion removed with live facts preserved (worker pool, port, journal segmentation); emoji stripped from headings; inflation deflated rather than reworded; the two phantom links surfaced as gaps rather than silently deleted; CLAUDE.md untouched.

evals.name: audit-only-no-edits
evals.prompt: audit ./evals/fixtures/repo-c/docs for AI slop and give me the list — file and line for everything. don't change any files yet
evals.expected_output: A file:line inventory with verdicts and rewrites, phantom links and the cross-file echo included, no files modified.

evals.name: code-comment-audit
evals.prompt: the comments in ./evals/fixtures/repo-c/src have the same AI voice as the docs — audit them and give me the list, don't edit anything
evals.expected_output: A file:line inventory over relay.py's comments (the leverage/facilitate line and the self-narration beside POOL_SIZE); the TODO line and the round-robin comment not flagged; no file modified.

evals.name: verify-claims
evals.prompt: the setup guide in ./evals/fixtures/repo-c/docs makes a lot of confident claims. which ones can't be verified from the repo, and which links are broken?
evals.expected_output: Both phantom links named (configuration.md, deploy.md); performance and readiness claims flagged as unverifiable against the fixture; the empty Prerequisites section and the unfilled clustering placeholder reported as gaps.
